principles: 1. The CustomerPaymentStatusReport message is sent by the Initiating party to the previous agent in the payment chain.

2. The pain.002 usage to provide notification of a rejected (negative) status is required by all agents, whereas the usage to provide a positive status will always be governed by a bilateral agreement between the agents.

3. Character Set: All proprietary and Text fields EXCLUDING Name and Address for all actors and Related Remittance Information and Remittance are limited to the FIN-X-Character set. All Name and Address for all actors, Related Remittance Information and Remittance Information (structured and unstructured), Email Address where included as part of a proxy element are extended to support the following additional characters: !#$&%*=^_’{|}~";<>@[\] < is replaced with < > is replaced with >

business_rules.name: CBPR_BusinessMessageIdentifier_FormalRule
business_rules.description: The Business Message Identifier must match the Message Identification in the Group Header.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [Full Message], every occurrence of [FullMessage/BusinessApplicationHeaderV02/BusinessMessageIdentifier] value must be equal to every occurrence of [FullMessage/Document/CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/GroupHeader/MessageIdentification] value

business_rules.name: CBPR_Related_Business_Application_Header_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If used, the Related BAH must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Business_Message_Identifier_TextualRule
business_rules.description: The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this element must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Message_Definition_Identifier_TextualRule
business_rules.description: The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Related_BAH_Business_Service_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If related BAH is present, it should transport the element Business Service.

business_rules.name: CBPR_MessageIdentification_PaymentInformationIdentification_FormalRule
business_rules.description: The Original Payment Information Identification must be the same as the Original Message Identification in the Original Group Information And Status.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10], every occurrence of [CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/OriginalPaymentInformationIdentification] value must be equal to every occurrence of [CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/OriginalMessageIdentification] value

business_rules.name: CBPR_Message_Identification_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Forwarding Agent should respect the Message ID provided by the Initiating Party of the pain.001 and pain.002.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Original_Message_Identification_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Original Message Identification must transport the Message Identification of the underlying payment (e.g. pain.001).

business_rules.name: CBPR_OriginalMessageNameIdentification_FormalRule
business_rules.description: This element must be populated with either pain.001.001.xx, or pain.008.001.xx.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/OriginalMessageNameIdentification], the value of every occurrence of [OriginalMessageNameIdentification] must comply with the following XML pattern : 'pain\.00[18]\.001\.[0-9]{2}'

business_rules.name: CBPR_Transaction_Status_Reject_Reason_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If TransactionStatus/Code equals RJCT, then “Status Reason Information/Reason” is mandatory.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/TransactionInformationAndStatus], if every occurrence of [TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus] has value included in the following list 'RJCT' , then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [TransactionInformationAndStatus/StatusReasonInformation/Reason] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Original_Instruction_Id_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If provided in the original pain.001, this Id is returned.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Original_End_To_End_Identification_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Must transport the EndToEnd Identification of the underlying pain.001.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Original_UETR_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If provided in the original pain.001, this value is returned.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Originator_Option_1_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If any BIC is absent, then Name is mandatory.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/TransactionInformationAndStatus/StatusReasonInformation/Originator], if the following element(s) [Originator/Identification/OrganisationIdentification/AnyBIC] is (are) absent , then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [Originator/Name] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Originator_Option_2_FormalRule
business_rules.description: If Postal Address is present, then Name is mandatory.
business_rules.formal_definition: For each [FullMessage/Document/CustomerPaymentStatusReportV10/OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/TransactionInformationAndStatus/StatusReasonInformation/Originator], if at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [Originator/PostalAddress] is (are) present , then at least one occurrence of the following element(s) [Originator/Name] must be present

business_rules.name: CBPR_Originator_Identification_TextualRule
business_rules.description: If AnyBIC is present, in addition to any other optional elements, in case of conflicting information it will always take precedence.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Duplication_Postal_Address_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Data present in structured elements within the Postal Address must not, under any circumstances be repeated in AddressLine.

business_rules.name: CBPR_Additional_Information_TextualRule
business_rules.description: Additional Information may only be used when Reason Code contains the code NARR.
